canon.note: AGENTS.md kit note firefly: Skill 1131002 costs 40% Max HP, regenerates 65% Max Energy; Ult 1131003 Complete Combustion; enhanced skill 1131009 (Deathstar Overload) applies Fire Weakness

fixtures.env: Solo E0 Firefly, energyStartFrac 0 (start-energy talent raises to 50% = 120 EN), stats atk 3000/spd 200 (traces on: SPD+5 -> eff 205, no ATK trace -> Module gamma sees 3000), vs a dummy Elite (atk 0 so only Firefly's own 40% Max HP drain applies, Lightning-only weakness), 3 cycles. Rotation: 1131001 Basic / 1131002 Skill (fills 120->240 EN) -> 1131003 auto-Ult (Complete Combustion, Countdown spd 70) -> 1131009 Deathstar Overload while CC is up -> post-CC normal actions 1131001/1131002

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Order: Flare Propulsion (1131001, Fire) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Skill 1131002 'Order: Aerial Bombardment' is the non-CC Fire Blast main hit (label 'Order: Aerial Bombardment', attackType skill).
Ultimate 1131003 'Complete Combustion' is cast from an auto-ult turn (charTurn convention: full energy replaces the action, AGENTS 30-09-2026).
Enhanced Skill 1131009 'Deathstar Overload' is the CC main hit (label 'Deathstar Overload', attackType skill).
firefly onStart: when starting energy is below 50% of the 240 cap it is raised to 120 EN (kit onStart, log 'talent: energy set to 50%').
Ultimate 1131003 puts Firefly into the Complete Combustion state, modelled as buff cc_state ('Complete Combustion').

Casting the auto-ult consumes the full 240 Energy pool (Energy.md canon: full-energy ult drops to 0 -> castUlt ENERGY_LOSS amount 240, reason ult_cost) and energy never exceeds the 240 cap afterwards.
A paid Ultimate refunds sp_base +5 Energy (Energy.md canon; kit logs 'Complete Combustion (energy +5)'); first ENERGY_GAIN of the battle is that refund, n = 5.
Complete Combustion grants Break DMG boost from 1131003 #1: mult('firefly','ult') at default Ult Lv.10 = 0.2 (PROG FIREFLY ult ladder L10, progression.ts:100; 0.25 only at Lv.15).
Module gamma (destruction.ts:23-26): +0.8% Break Effect per 10 ATK above 1800, cap 360%; atk 3000 -> floor(1200/10)*0.008 = 0.96.
Turn order: the first action is Skill 1131002 (120 -> 240 EN via the 65% Max Energy regen, direct write), the following turn auto-ults (charTurn full-energy rule).
Deathstar Overload 1131009 can only happen after Ultimate 1131003 has entered Complete Combustion (kit gates the enhanced kit on buff cc_state).
Normal Basic 1131001 'Order: Flare Propulsion' happens only after the CC Countdown (timer spd 70, onCcEnd -> exitCc) has ended Complete Combustion.
Between the Ultimate cast and the first Deathstar hit no normal Basic 1131001 can fire (kit picks the enhanced branch while cc_state is up; own-turn ult cannot basic).
Enhanced Skill 1131009 applies Fire Weakness to the enemies (destruction.ts:82 applyWeakness loop; fixture Elite starts Lightning-only, engine logs 'Elite gains Fire weakness').
E1 'In Reddened Chrysalis' grants ff_e1_def DEF-ignore on the Enhanced Skill; at E0 the buff must never be applied (kit eidolon guard).
